name: branded_food
title: A branded food is logged from its label, not guessed

steps.say: i had a 45g bar of cadbury dairy milk
steps.reply:
I've logged your 45 g Cadbury Dairy Milk as a snack: **240 kcal, 3.3 g protein, 25.7 g carbs, 13.5 g fat, 0.9 g fibre**.

- **Where the numbers come from:** the standard UK Dairy Milk label per 100 g, scaled down to 45 g. I worked from memory of the label and didn't check a pack or website. The Indian Dairy Milk recipe can differ a little.
- **Date:** you mentioned it at midnight, so I logged it on **Mon 19 Oct**. Tell me if you meant today and I'll move it.
